SELECT s.* FROM stores s JOIN ( SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS wishlist_count FROM wishlists GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY wishlist_count DESC ) w ON s.store_id = w.store_id;
select * from stores where storeId = #{storeId}

SELECT s.*, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avgRating, COUNT(r.review_id) AS countRating FROM stores s INNER JOIN reviews r ON s.store_id = r.store_id WHERE s.road_address REGEXP CONCAT('(^| )', #{keyword}, '( |$)') GROUP BY s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id

SELECT s.store_id, s.owner_id, s.store_name, s.road_address, s.local_number, s.number1, s.number2, s.description, s.file_name, s.store_type, ROUND(AVG(r.rating),2) AS avgRating, COUNT(r.review_id) AS countRating FROM stores s INNER JOIN reviews r ON s.store_id = r.store_id WHERE s.store_type = #{keyword} GROUP BY s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id
select menu_name, price, description, file_name from menu where store_id=#{storeId} order by display_no asc

SELECT r.*, m.login_id AS writerId, COUNT(rl.review_id) AS likes FROM reviews r INNER JOIN members m ON r.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN review_like rl ON r.review_id = rl.review_id WHERE r.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY r.review_id, m.login_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
select rating, count(rating) as countScoreRating from reviews where store_id=#{storeId} group by rating order by rating desc

SELECT ROUND(SUM(taste = 5) / COUNT(taste) * 100, 0) AS taste_percent, ROUND(SUM(mood = 5) / COUNT(mood) * 100, 0) AS mood_percent, ROUND(SUM(service = 5) / COUNT(service) * 100, 0) AS service_percent, ROUND(SUM(clean = 5) / COUNT(clean) * 100, 0) AS clean_percent FROM reviews WHERE store_id = #{storeId};
